resources.string: Primary in %1$d min · Secondary in %2$d min
When both tones are scheduled for the same minute, Primary plays and Secondary is skipped.
For reliable chimes, disable Battery Optimization for bellBird.\n\nSettings → Apps → bellBird → Battery → Unrestricted

When you start the service or change an interval, the scheduler finds the next multiple of your interval from the current clock time. For example, if it\'s 2:17 and your primary interval is 30 min, the first chime fires at 2:30, then 3:00, 3:30, and so on.

Intervals are counted from the exact moment this option is turned on rather than aligning to clock boundaries. For example, turning it on at 2:17 with a 30-min interval gives chimes at 2:47, 3:17, 3:47… If the interval is changed while “Start Immediately” is already on, the start-time will be reset.
Tap the toggle to open Settings and grant "Alarms & reminders" — required for exact scheduling.
